title: chore(changeset): put the summary line first in six changesets
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · 18.2.0 release prep · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WV2t4SJjcpQk4Wkqfp7kPN)_

Refs #26429

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：6 个 changeset 的正文把 `Clause-②:` / `Metadata-protocol:` 两行写在了最前面。这次把这两行挪到第一段之后，和 `.changeset/` 里其余文件的写法一致。一个字都没改，只是调整顺序。
- 为什么改：changesets 拿正文第一行当 CHANGELOG 的标题，所以这 6 条在 18.2.0 的 CHANGELOG 和 GitHub Release 里标题会显示成 "Clause-②: no"。另外，`classifyReleaseBullet` 不读标题行上的声明，所以 `spec-form-object-name-shared` 的 `Clause-②: yes (widening)` 被分到了「其他修复」，本该在「新增能力」。
- 风险：只改 `.changeset/`，不改代码。
- 回滚：revert 即可。

## What changes

These six files have the declaration block moved below the first paragraph:

- `25495-org-default-currency`
- `25576-admin-rescue-comment-i18n`
- `25611-inline-transform-null-sentinel`
- `25639-lockstep-exact-internal-deps`
- `default-org-owner-currency`
- `spec-form-object-name-shared`

Each file keeps the same lines, and none is reworded.

Found by #26429's writer (see the os-dev-report on #26429, `out_of_scope_findings`).

## Verification

Every `.changeset/*.md` on this head was parsed with `@changesets/parse`, and each summary was fed to `classifyReleaseBullet` as a CHANGELOG bullet:

- Changesets whose summary line is a declaration: 6 on `main` (exactly the six above), 0 on this head.
- `spec-form-object-name-shared` was `other` on `main` and is `added` on this head. The other five stay `other`, which their `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` calls for.
- Every file parses.

Check Changeset will be red here: this PR edits changesets that other PRs added (the foreign-changeset rule, #17712). That is deliberate. Check Changeset is not a required check, and the same thing happened on #26458. This PR is not labelled `skip-changeset` because it edits existing changesets.

Follow-up for #26494: `spec-form-object-name-shared` moves from 其他修复 to 新增能力 on the 18-2 page.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (none)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. This PR only edits existing changesets.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 速读 block excepted, as on #26486).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
